scope: Full ROADMAP SUS-00 through SUS-25; section 24 sequence and exact twenty section-25 criteria, with approved evaluation requirements

criteria.roadmap_criterion: Domain contract is stable and documented.
criteria.observation: Original architecture is approved; later thermal/source/acceptance scopes still need their scoped decision.

criteria.roadmap_criterion: Master taxonomy is stable.
criteria.observation: Original naming coverage and current assets exist; this is not a final release stability decision.

criteria.roadmap_criterion: Evidence and provenance schema is enforced.
criteria.observation: Schema/reference and source controls pass; actual source authenticity/fitness is separate.

criteria.roadmap_criterion: Common state and I/O contracts are documented.
criteria.observation: Common I/O/state are documented; no new shared schema was introduced by recent helpers.

criteria.roadmap_criterion: Core data skills pass evaluations.
criteria.observation: Literal CSV/workbook and adversarial checks exist; actual agent/source behavior has narrower evidence.

criteria.roadmap_criterion: Scope 1 and Scope 2 calculations pass known-answer tests.
criteria.observation: Controlled scope calculations pass; synthetic factors cannot qualify a real inventory.

criteria.roadmap_criterion: Scope 3 handling includes evidence and uncertainty controls.
criteria.observation: Selected source/category/coverage/uncertainty controls exist; required food-case freight/travel branches remain to compose.

criteria.roadmap_criterion: Energy, waste, water, and resource-efficiency workflows are functional.
criteria.observation: Selected physical analyses are functional in controlled inputs; required two-facility food-case workflow is not yet executed.

criteria.roadmap_criterion: Business-case analysis is testable and traceable.
criteria.observation: Explicit cash-flow arithmetic is traceable; benefit attribution and professional decisions are not verified.

criteria.roadmap_criterion: Router behavior is scenario tested.
criteria.observation: Seven existing asset checks and fixture routing exist; independent instruction-following run remains pending.

criteria.roadmap_criterion: Framework adapters are versioned.
criteria.observation: Initial adapter list is optional (may cover); do not require every named licensed framework merely to inflate scope. Selected candidate mappings retain source/currentness/rights limits.

criteria.roadmap_criterion: Jurisdiction modules are isolated from core skills.
criteria.observation: Core and jurisdiction modules are separated; screening remains distinct from legal determination.

criteria.roadmap_criterion: Canadian reference pack has source and version controls.
criteria.observation: Canonical module pins and private byte receipts exist; encoding/index/source/sector/legal/rights review is unresolved.

criteria.roadmap_criterion: Environmental claims guardrails are tested.
criteria.observation: Controlled claim/injection/refusal tests exist; actual reviewer/source/publication authority is not inferred.

criteria.roadmap_criterion: Professional-review states propagate through composed workflows.
criteria.observation: Complete prior decisions survive controlled source/manager composition; real reviewer authority remains separate.

criteria.roadmap_criterion: Example workflows are reproducible.
criteria.observation: Windows 3.11/3.12/3.14 evidence exists for recorded snapshots; native Linux/other host discovery is unverified.

criteria.roadmap_criterion: Documentation explains limitations and intended use.
criteria.observation: Limits and consumption guidance exist; documentation alone does not prove live host usability.

criteria.roadmap_criterion: Security and contribution guidance is present.
criteria.observation: Files exist; license/public contribution terms and private reporting channel are explicit unresolved owner decisions.

criteria.roadmap_criterion: Public examples contain no confidential or proprietary data.
criteria.observation: Limited pattern/package inventory narrows review; no blanket absence-of-private/proprietary-data conclusion follows.

criteria.roadmap_criterion: v1 acceptance scenarios pass.
criteria.observation: Approved evaluation layer explicitly requires a 150-employee, two-facility food manufacturer with ten input categories. New source ingestion is prepared; complete pipeline and behavioral acceptance remain unproven.

next_technical_work: Compose the required food-manufacturer source through selected fuel/direct emissions, purchased energy, materials/water/waste, freight/travel, finance/targets/roadmap/KPIs/disclosure with exact source/state and refusal controls; keep unknown refrigerant and unsupported factors explicit.
